lead.zh: 这期 WealthTrack 介绍阿克瑞如何寻找“复利机器”。这里依据发布方介绍与页面说明整理，完整访谈视频可在站内展开观看。
lead.en: This WealthTrack episode introduces Akre’s search for compounding businesses. This guide uses the publisher’s description; the original video can be watched here.

heading.zh: 持续产生高回报的企业

paragraphs.zh: 采访主题是能够为股东长期创造价值的企业。这种能力比短期市场情绪更接近阿克瑞关心的经营问题。
paragraphs.en: The episode concerns businesses creating long-term shareholder value, directing attention towards business economics rather than market sentiment.

paragraphs.zh: 页面讨论资本留在企业或返还股东的选择。阅读时需要判断再投入资金是否能够继续取得有吸引力的回报。
paragraphs.en: The page discusses retaining capital or returning it to shareholders. Examine whether reinvested funds can earn attractive returns.

paragraphs.zh: 发布方强调他寻找这类企业后倾向长期持有。长期持有仍需要观察经营条件，而非忽略它们。
paragraphs.en: The publisher emphasises long holding periods after finding such businesses. This still requires attention to their operating conditions.
